content: Prisma P2002 (unique constraint violation) is caught via 'e instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && e.code === "P2002"' or structurally via 'code' in err. For composite unique constraints (e.g. @@unique([domainId, slug])), a pre-check findUnique gives a fast/friendly error path but only the P2002 catch is race-safe under concurrent writes.
